title: FOSS Foundation Leadership Schema
description: Current governing people (board, officers, paid staff) for a FOSS foundation, keyed by the same identifier as its _foundations record. Complements the foundation model's boardSize / boardType / numberOfEmployees counts with the named individuals. Person type derives from Schema.org Person. Every fact carries a source URL and a confidence; absent data is null, never guessed.

commonName.title: Common Name
commonName.description: Common name of the foundation, for readability.

asOf.title: As Of Date
asOf.description: Date this leadership roster was last verified against source. Answers the open metadata-freshness question in CONTRIBUTING.

sources.title: Sources
sources.description: Official URLs the roster was verified against.

people.title: People
people.description: Governing individuals. Include only verifiable roles; never guess.

name.title: Name
name.description: Full name exactly as the foundation publishes it.

personId.title: Person ID
personId.description: Stable cross-foundation id; null until entity resolution assigns one.

roles.title: Roles
roles.description: One or more governance roles held by this person.

role.title: Role
role.description: Role title as published, e.g. President, Board Director.

contact.title: Contact
contact.description: Per-person contact if the foundation publishes it, else null.

termStart.title: Term Start
termStart.description: Only if explicitly stated by the foundation, else null.

termEnd.title: Term End
termEnd.description: Only if explicitly stated by the foundation, else null.

sourceUrl.title: Source URL
sourceUrl.description: Page the person and role were read from.

derived.title: Derived
derived.description: How the record was captured, e.g. org_live.

confidence.title: Confidence
confidence.description: 1.0 for facts stated verbatim; lower when inferred, with a note in the body.
